item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.16 (46) for Mac

Remove the demo launcher, guide and bundled script. New workspaces start empty; existing productions and imported samples remain editable.

Breakdown export now produces interoperable CSV with Unicode, quoted fields and clear columns. Complete .productiondesk files preserve breakdowns, tags, script/PDF attachments, shots, lined annotations, schedules and project settings.

Includes the Mac updater startup and safe retry fix from 1.5.15 (45). Offline operation, signature validation and save-before-install remain in effect.
